results.summary_before: This is a 4-bit signed adder-subtractor built from multiplexers, half adders, and full adders. Two 4-bit operands a and b are supplied on ui_in, and the two sign bits on uio select one of four operations: A+B, -A+B, A-B, or -A-B, with the 4-bit result on uo and sign outputs on uio. The design was verified in QuestaSim using an extensive testbench covering the operation modes. No external hardware is needed.

results.summary_before: This design implements a basic oscilloscope and signal generator on an ASIC, using an external ADC, DAC, FRAM, and HDMI Pmod. It samples input signals, buffers them in FRAM, and displays waveforms on an HDMI screen, with the display rotated 90 degrees due to memory constraints. The signal generator uses direct digital synthesis to produce sine, square, triangle, and sawtooth waves, and the oscilloscope supports trigger functionality. The design requires multiple external Pmods and outputs settings via UART.
